title: Kolmogorov, quasi-sober and sober properties pass to locally closed subspaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the inheritance of the separation properties by locally closed subspaces (author lemma at source lines 1212-1221, label lemma-sober-subspace): Kolmogorov passes to any subspace, quasi-sober and sober pass to locally closed subspaces. The proof (source lines 1223-1246) has real content in part (2): writing the locally closed subspace as the intersection of an open and a closed subset, the author takes the closure in the ambient space of an irreducible closed subset of the subspace and argues that its generic point lies in the subspace and therefore serves as a generic point there, which is exactly where quasi-sobriety of the ambient space is consumed (proof lines 1229-1243). Part (1) is a short closure computation and part (3) is the immediate combination, as the author says. H2.
